name: AppsMirror

sources.title: Homepage — active app review/news blog (posts through Sep 2026), iPhone/Android/Web App sections
Submit Your App For Review — mentions 'Free App Review and Featured App Review' sections; Wufoo form; $249 10-blog Network Review

conditions: Submit page references a 'Free App Review' section and a 'Free Review' offer via AppMarketingPlus, but the page's promoted packages (Featured review, $249 Network Review across 10 blogs) are paid — a purely free publication is not guaranteed
requirements: Focus is mobile apps: iPhone/iPad, Android; a Web App category also exists
Intake is a Wufoo form embedded on the submit page (amp2.wufoo.com/forms/w1acnr940byz9va)

Part of the AppMarketingPlus review network — same operator ring as appiod.com, apps400.com, webapprater.com, appsthunder.com, appslisto.com, apps4review.com, game400.com, gadget400.com, appsmamma.com, appstimes.in
preparation: App name, store link or web app URL
Decide free vs paid path: free review offer vs Featured review vs $249 Network Review (10 sites)
workflow: Fill the embedded Wufoo form with app details
For the free route, use the AppMarketingPlus 'Free Review' link — a marketing-agency lead-gen flow
Paid: Network Review is $249 for reviews on 10 partner blogs; Featured App Review pricing is unpublished
Published reviews appear under /category/reviews or the platform sections
watchFor: Paid-review farm ring run by AppMarketingPlus/GegoSoft — 'free review' is a lead magnet; expect upsell email
Do not treat resulting coverage as earned editorial
Same network as several other batch domains (appiod.com, apps400.com, webapprater.com) — network placement is one package, not independent placements
Site sells ad placements and 'Work with us' freelance-review writing — reviews are produced by freelancers
countsAsLive: A review post naming the product is published on appsmirror.com under a category (iPhone/Android/Web App/Reviews)
unknowns: Whether the unpaid Wufoo submission alone produces a published review
